notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.19.1
notes.content:
[p]Hello all,[/p][p]We’re pushing a small patch to address a few issues, add some new content, and make minor improvements.[/p][p][b]
New Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new units: [/p][list][*][p][b]Bone Wraith, [/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Skeleton Knight[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Skeleton Marksman[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Dark Necromancer[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Modified the way the [b]Potential UI[/b] is displayed for better clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where summoned units did not correctly set their dodge position.[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected some in-game text with grammar errors.[/p][/*][/list][p]We’ve also updated our feedback form for reporting bugs and issues. You can find it here: [url="https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1H5EaujuY5xqV2gCMVqN4d-iwkpKnUQ8zXHeZJzAdXA0/edit?gid=0#gid=0"]Mini Dungeons Feedback Form [/url][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your continued support and feedback![/p][p]— The Mini Dungeons Team[/p]

notes.title: Hotfix v0.18.3
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone,

We’re releasing a hotfix to address a couple of issues found in-game. A larger patch is scheduled for release in the coming weeks.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Cheat Mode appeared in-game.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Expanded the notification bar to support longer text.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes: v0.18.2
notes.content: [p]Hello all! We've been hard at work fixing bugs and issues since launch. Below is a list of all the changes we've implemented. Thank you to everyone who's supported us and left feedback since launch! [/p][p][/p][p][b]New Features:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a new Arm item, [i]Shield[/i], which increases defence and enables the Defend action.[/p][/*][*][p]Added six Level 6 items that were previously missing.[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing video content.[/p][/*][*][p]Added new sound effects and background music.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated Pyro’s Grand Ceremony to address lag during Quick Time Events (QTEs).[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Ghoul damage by 5.[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the Potential Info UI by increasing its size.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted values for several potentials.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the lighting for certain candles in Level 1.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the player disappears after a game over.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where items not equipped could still be sold.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where certain object pools were not functioning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Mirror object in Vin’s [i]Shadow Dance[/i] ability didn’t work.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a chest bug where unique items would not generate.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug causing unique items to degrade to a lower level.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with the weapon merchant not offering weapon slots.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed input delay when interacting with NPCs.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed long loading times.[/p][/*][/list]
